title: Cooking Recipes (DS)
wikitext:
[[File:CookingDS.png|thumb|160px]] There are a total of 134 recipes in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon: DS Cute]].'' Before the player can cook, a kitchen and utensils are required. The kitchen can be purchased from the [[The Sprite Station (DS)#Channel 2: TV Shopping|TV Shopping channel]] after the first house upgrade is completed. Additional utensils can also be purchased from the TV Shopping channel. ==Recipes== Several recipes require ingredients to be at a specific size, which will be specified. If there is no size specified, then the size of the ingredients do not matter. ===Frying Pan Recipes=== There are 23 recipes in this category: {| class="article-table sortable" !
